standard_prerequisites: Cited Sobolev/elliptic/good-unknown tools; original model and qualified Proposition4.1 (2517) retained in complete work.
core_obligations: H3: Given the original Sobolev/elliptic tools, Alinhac good-unknown framework and the already qualified linear hidden-boundary trace estimate (2517), the nonlinear moving-contact-line closure still requires a regularizing Hanzawa map with half-derivative gain, second-order good unknowns for the interior potential, recovery of normal derivatives through the partially characteristic transmission system, and coupled energy/boundary estimates. At critical m=3 the author cannot use a bound on the time derivative of the elevation gradient in L-infinity; a special embedding/interpolation estimate and bootstrap preserve the initial transverse contact margins. Count the complete nonlinear a priori Theorem1.3 once, not its twelve energy/embedding helper records. This asserts bounds for an existing regular solution, not existence or well-posedness.
proof_roadmap: Regularizing Hanzawa map; second-order good unknowns; coupled boundary energy; critical m3 transversality bootstrap; complete final proof.
